$description: Icons: Solar Bold Duotone draws a solid shape and a faded shape. Decision 0043: the faded half is clearly lighter than the solid half (the two tones were too close to tell apart); the solid half carries the 3:1 contrast.

duo-opacity.$description: Opacity of the faded half of a duotone icon.

window-control-tone.$description: Opacity of the second tone in a window control's Line Duotone icon, at rest, hover and press (decision 0079): the two tones sit close, so Minimize, Maximize, Restore and Close each read as one mark; the first tone carries the 3:1.
